class.name: FmodAudioStreamPlayer3D
class.brief_description: A 3D node for playing FMOD audio streams with full spatial audio support.
class.description: Plays [FmodAudioStream] in 3D using FMOD positioning, rolloff, optional Doppler tracking, and an emission cone. Playback controls, pitch, volume, and bus routing are shared with the other FMOD players.

method.name: play
method.description: Starts or restarts playback at [param from_position], in seconds. Use a nonnegative position.

method.name: seek
method.description: Seeks to the specified position in seconds during playback. This can be called while playing or paused.

method.name: get_playback_position
method.description: Returns the playback position in seconds, including while paused. Returns [code]0.0[/code] if there is no valid playback channel.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops playback and resets the position to the beginning.

method.name: set_stream
method.description: Stops the current playback and assigns [param stream]. Playback must be started again with [method play].

method.name: get_stream
method.description: Returns the [FmodAudioStream] currently assigned to this player. Returns [code]null[/code] if no stream is set.

method.name: preload_stream
method.description: Preloads the assigned stream by creating its internal [FmodSound]. Returns [code]false[/code] if no stream is assigned or sound creation fails.

method.name: set_attenuation_model
method.description: Sets the attenuation model for distance-based volume falloff. See [enum AttenuationModel] for available options.

method.name: get_attenuation_model
method.description: Returns the current attenuation model. See [enum AttenuationModel] for possible values.

method.name: set_volume_db
method.description: Sets the volume in decibels. [code]0.0[/code] is unity gain. Negative values attenuate, positive values amplify (if supported).

method.name: get_volume_db
method.description: Returns the current volume in decibels. The default value is [code]0.0[/code] dB (unity gain).

method.name: set_unit_size
method.description: Sets the minimum rolloff distance in scene units, clamped to at least [code]0.001[/code]. Also scales [member max_distance] when configuring FMOD.

method.name: get_unit_size
method.description: Returns the minimum rolloff distance in scene units.

method.name: set_pitch_scale
method.description: Sets the pitch scale of the audio playback. [code]1.0[/code] is normal pitch. Higher values increase pitch and playback speed.

method.name: get_pitch_scale
method.description: Returns the current pitch scale of the audio playback. [code]1.0[/code] is the default pitch, [code]0.5[/code] is one octave lower, [code]2.0[/code] is one octave higher.

method.name: set_playing
method.description: Controls playback state. Setting to [code]true[/code] starts playback from the beginning. Setting to [code]false[/code] stops playback.

method.name: is_playing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a playback channel is active, including while paused.

method.name: set_auto_play
method.description: Sets [member auto_play]. Automatic playback is deferred until the node is ready and is disabled in the editor.

method.name: is_autoplay_enabled
method.description: Returns whether [member auto_play] is enabled.

method.name: set_preload_on_set_stream
method.description: If enabled, assigning [member stream] immediately preloads it.

method.name: is_preload_on_set_stream_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if streams are preloaded as soon as they are assigned.

method.name: set_stream_paused
method.description: Pauses or resumes playback without changing position.

method.name: get_stream_paused
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the stream playback is currently paused.

method.name: set_max_distance
method.description: Sets the maximum rolloff distance multiplier, clamped to at least [code]0.01[/code]. FMOD receives [param distance] multiplied by [member unit_size]. The attenuation model determines behavior beyond that distance. In [constant ATTENUATION_DISABLED] mode, a flat custom rolloff curve keeps distance gain at unity regardless of this setting.

method.name: get_max_distance
method.description: Returns the maximum rolloff distance multiplier. Multiply it by [member unit_size] to obtain the distance passed to FMOD. In [constant ATTENUATION_DISABLED] mode, a flat custom rolloff curve keeps distance gain at unity regardless of this setting.

method.name: set_bus
method.description: Selects the bus used when the next playback channel is created. Changing this value does not reroute an existing channel. If the bus is not found in [FmodAudioBusLayout], playback uses the master channel group.

method.name: get_bus
method.description: Returns the name of the audio bus this player outputs to. The default value is [code]&"Master"[/code].

method.name: set_area_mask
method.description: Stores [param mask]. Area-based audio filtering is not implemented by this player.

method.name: get_area_mask
method.description: Returns the stored area mask. It currently has no effect on playback.

method.name: set_emission_angle_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables the directional emission cone. When enabled, sound is projected in a cone rather than omnidirectionally.

method.name: is_emission_angle_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the emission angle cone is enabled. When enabled, sound is directional within the configured cone.

method.name: set_emission_angle
method.description: Sets the inner emission angle in degrees, clamped to [code]0.0[/code] through [code]90.0[/code]. The inspector and saved scenes use degrees without conversion. Sound is at full volume within this cone and attenuated outside.

method.name: get_emission_angle
method.description: Returns the inner emission angle in degrees. Sound is at full volume within this cone. The default value is [code]45.0[/code] degrees.

method.name: set_emission_angle_filter_attenuation_db
method.description: Sets the attenuation outside the emission cone in dB, clamped to [code]-80.0[/code] through [code]0.0[/code]. More negative values create a sharper directional effect.

method.name: get_emission_angle_filter_attenuation_db
method.description: Returns the attenuation outside the emission cone in dB. The default value is [code]-12.0[/code] dB.

method.name: set_attenuation_filter_cutoff_hz
method.description: Center frequency passed to FMOD's custom distance filter, in Hz. Clamped to [code]10.0[/code] through [code]22050.0[/code].

method.name: get_attenuation_filter_cutoff_hz
method.description: Center frequency passed to FMOD's custom distance filter, in Hz. Clamped to [code]10.0[/code] through [code]22050.0[/code].

method.name: set_attenuation_filter_db
method.description: Sets [member attenuation_filter_db]. Updates the native filter immediately during playback.

method.name: get_attenuation_filter_db
method.description: Returns [member attenuation_filter_db] in dB.

method.name: set_doppler_tracking
method.description: Sets the doppler tracking mode for velocity-based pitch changes. See [enum DopplerTracking] for available options.

method.name: get_doppler_tracking
method.description: Returns the current doppler tracking mode. See [enum DopplerTracking] for possible values.

members.member: The [FmodAudioStream] resource to play. In the editor, its resource picker displays a waveform preview. Expanding the resource exposes the inspector audition panel, which shares the same waveform cache. Assigning another stream stops current playback.
Volume in decibels. [code]0.0[/code] is unity gain, negative values attenuate.
Minimum rolloff distance in scene units. Also scales [member max_distance] when configuring FMOD.
Pitch scale of the audio. [code]1.0[/code] is the default pitch.
Current playback state. Can be set to start/stop playback.
If [code]true[/code], defers playback until the node is ready, outside the editor.
If [code]true[/code], assigning a stream creates its internal [FmodSound] immediately instead of waiting for the first playback.

Maximum rolloff distance multiplier. The distance passed to FMOD is this value multiplied by [member unit_size]; it is not a universal hard cutoff. In [constant ATTENUATION_DISABLED] mode, a flat custom rolloff curve keeps distance gain at unity regardless of this setting.

Destination bus name from [method FmodServer.get_bus_names]. Godot provides the list when bus synchronization is enabled; independent mode uses [method FmodServer.get_audio_bus_layout]. An unknown or renamed destination falls back to [code]Master[/code] when playback starts. Changing the name does not reroute an existing channel.
Stored area mask. Area-based audio filtering is not implemented.
Inner emission angle in degrees, clamped to [code]0.0[/code] through [code]90.0[/code]. The inspector and saved scenes use degrees without conversion.
Attenuation outside the emission cone in dB, clamped to [code]-80.0[/code] through [code]0.0[/code].
Center frequency passed to FMOD's custom distance filter, in Hz. Clamped to [code]10.0[/code] through [code]22050.0[/code].

Distance-filter level in dB, clamped to [code]-80.0[/code] through [code]0.0[/code]. [code]0.0[/code] bypasses filtering; more negative values increase filtering around [member attenuation_filter_cutoff_hz]. This controls filter strength, not a uniform volume reduction. The player converts dB to the native filter amount as [code]1 - pow(10, db / 20)[/code]. Requires [code]audio/fmod/init_flags/channel_distance_filter[/code] to be enabled before the FMOD system is initialized. Restart the project after changing this setting.
Doppler effect tracking mode. See [enum DopplerTracking].

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted when the playback channel ends. Calling [method stop] or replacing [member stream] does not emit this signal.

constants.constant: Inverse distance attenuation model. Volume falls off as 1/distance. This is a realistic model for point sources in free field.
Uses FMOD inverse-tapered rolloff ([constant FmodSystem.FMOD_MODE_3D_INVERSETAPEREDROLLOFF]). This is not a pure inverse-square volume curve.
Uses FMOD linear rolloff between [member unit_size] and [member max_distance] multiplied by [member unit_size].

Uses a flat custom rolloff curve with unity gain at every distance. Preserves 3D panning, Doppler and emission-cone settings. [member unit_size] and [member max_distance] do not affect distance gain in this mode.
Doppler effect is disabled. No pitch changes based on velocity.
Doppler effect is calculated during the idle/process step. Suitable for visual-only movement tracking.
Doppler effect is calculated during the physics step. Recommended for physics-based movement for accurate results.
